name: zeriong-commit
description: Author a header + body git commit message, run `git commit`, then push to the remote (fast-forward only, never force). Conforms to project rules (commitlint / husky / pre-commit) when present and falls back to Conventional Commits (header ≤ 50 / body ≤ 72). Hardcodes author/committer to jaeryong95@gmail.com and forbids any Claude attribution.
